skipped.explicit: An explicit method's step is held by stability below about 1e-3 s here, so crossing 1e11 s would take on the order of 1e14 steps.
An explicit method's step is held by stability near 3.3/μ on the slow flanks, about 2.4 million steps a period; over two periods its cost says nothing about accuracy.

native.rule: limits an idle baseline plus 1.0; full gate: AC power, no compiler, build tool, Konjugate Electron, interaction test or Docker, 1-minute load below 2.61 for 120 s; before every timed run: AC power, none of those, other processes below 1.01 cores
